evidence: qwen3-coder: "A triangle is the minimal bad configuration"; deepseek-v4-flash checks "c in adj[b]" after finding two neighbors; glm-5 says "Find lexicographically smallest triangle"; gpt-oss-120b builds an adjacency matrix and bitsets for pairwise edge tests
affordance_in_statement: You must identify a set of three chemicals that inherently cannot be divided across the two planes. Specifically, you must find three chemicals such that every possible way of assigning these three to the two planes forces at least one listed reactive pair to share a plane.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving rewording that removes this shortcut: for exactly three objects and two planes, the stated obstruction is intrinsically equivalent to the three pairwise reactive edges forming a triangle. Removing it requires changing the certificate or the underlying task.
